'''Hunter's Valley''' was a valley located in the [[Rotoksa Mountain Range]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sakiya]]. The owners of the nearby [[Rotoksa Ridge Grand Lodge]] transformed the valley into a game preserve by importing [[Species/Legends|Species]] from around [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] trapping them with a [[Particle shield/Legends|particle shield]], so that they could be easily hunted.<ref name="LoNH" />
